newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 24.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 24.

text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Parliament stripped MP Valdis Krisbergs of his parliamentary immunity, following fraud allegations.

- Court hearings against reelected Daugavpils mayor Aleksei Vidavski on violations of the local election law are expected to continue. The law bars former communists, who actively worked against Latvia's independence, from taking public posts.
- Government parties are today expected to sign a co-operation agreement on Riga city council.
